$required_projections_comment: CHECK 3 (completeness). Checks 1 and 2 reason about what WAS emitted, so neither can see
the cheapest uniform error: emitting less. What must appear cannot be derived from the
output, so it is declared here — and every entry is a POINTER into the declaration, so a
record added there becomes an obligation with no edit to this file.
$allowed_cells_comment: SHORT GENERATOR TOKENS, DECLARED BECAUSE THEY CANNOT NORMALISE. MIN_SLOT is 6: a
declared string shorter than that may not stand in for a template slot, because a
corpus hit on 'no' or '5' would be coincidence and normalising on it would erase the
sentence rather than its values. So every sub-MIN_SLOT cell the generator emits has to
be declared here by hand or CHECK 1 reports it as unprovenanced.
These five were an oversight of exactly that kind, and the asymmetry shows it: 'YES'
was declared and 'no' was not, though the state machine table emits them in pairs;
'GATE' was declared and its value 'OPEN' was not; 'RECORDS ADMITTING FREEZE' was
declared and its count was not. The labels were captured and several of their values
'0' and '5' are counts and will change. Declaring the digit is weaker than declaring a
pattern, and this mechanism has no pattern form — the alternative was to pin whole
lines carrying today's counts in allowed_lines, which goes stale the next time a record
is registered. A cell holding only a digit carries no normative text, so the weaker
declaration costs nothing this check is defending.
